settings.pose_source: Canonical same-seed baseline control-snapshot poses; identical across all four replay cases.

definitions.best_worst: Favourable/adverse endpoints for measurement availability within this factorial design, not a globally optimal sensor or a navigation success ranking.
definitions.target_opportunities: Emitted rays intersecting the isolated study-target geometry before LOS/range tests.
definitions.eligible_echoes: Nearest opaque hit is the target and its range satisfies the inclusive sensor range gate.
definitions.detected_returns: Observed target detections; denominator for conditional target P_D is eligible_echoes, not all emitted rays.
definitions.mean_eligible_power_w: Analytical noiseless power over every eligible target echo, avoiding threshold-selection bias.
definitions.mean_power_w: Measured power conditional on target detection; this average is selection biased near threshold.
definitions.range_rmse_m: Measured-minus-true target range RMS conditional on detected target returns; undefined when none detected.
definitions.distance_bins: Whole snapshots grouped by mean eligible target range; sums use all eligible/detected target echoes in those snapshots, not an exact per-ray range histogram.
definitions.observed_fraction: Common ROI XY cells with measured endpoints; neither map accuracy nor inferred free/traversable space.
definitions.sampling: Measurements_per_cycle controls angular sampling density (1 versus 4 degrees), not emitted optical power.
definitions.sensor_state: Known robot position/yaw vary along the same fixed replay trajectory; mount orientation and height are constant.
definitions.paired_seed: Same seed labels and poses are paired, but changed beam counts change RNG consumption; per-ray noise is not forced identical.

limitations: Diffuse coefficients and receiver optics are illustrative virtual stress settings, not calibrated real paints or a specific LiDAR.
The dark coefficient 5e-5 is deliberately selected to cross the model's receiver threshold over the recorded approach/departure.
Only the designated study_target material changes; other objects, geometry, atmosphere, noise, mount angles and FOV stay fixed.
A high density scan emits four times as many rays; target intersections need not scale by exactly four because of angular alignment.
Matched replay isolates measurement causes; closed-loop trajectories can subsequently diverge because measurements drive the controller.
Recorded poses are exact and scans are ideal snapshots; no SLAM, within-sweep motion, atmospheric backscatter or moving targets.
Three paired seeds are descriptive rather than a population reliability estimate.
